runtime_subset: Core Ruby Liquid with supplied hashes only; or static schema/reference contracts. No Shopify service emulation.
prompt:
Fix snippets/spec-sheet.liquid so it renders a product specification list. Inputs (all top-level variables, always supplied): - heading: string or null. - specs: array (never null, may be empty) of objects. Every object always has the keys: - label: string (never null). - value: string or null. - unit: string or null. - max_rows: integer or null. Rules: 1. A spec is visible only if its value is non-null and non-blank after trimming leading/trailing whitespace. Invisible specs are skipped entirely. 2. If there are no visible specs, output nothing at all (empty string), even if heading is set. 3. Row limit: if max_rows is a positive integer smaller than the number of visible specs, show only the first max_rows visible specs (in input order); otherwise (null, 0, negative, or >= number of visible specs) show all visible specs. 4. Output, with no whitespace anywhere between tags:
[HEADING]
[ROWS]
[MORE]
- HEADING:

TEXT

where TEXT is the trimmed heading; omitted entirely if heading is null or blank after trimming. - Each shown row:
LABEL
VALUE
where LABEL is the trimmed label, and VALUE is the trimmed value followed, only if unit is non-null and non-blank after trimming, by one space and the trimmed unit. - MORE: if some visible specs were cut off by the row limit,

+N more

where N is the number of visible specs not shown (blank specs never count); otherwise omitted. 5. All text (heading, label, value, unit) must be HTML-escaped (& < > " become & < > "). Use only core Liquid. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/spec-sheet.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
